ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_cost_gap_exp_neg_distilled_safe
ir.intuition: Uses cost gap to weight a stable negative log sigmoid loss on log-prob margin with clamping to avoid numerics.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
cg = batch['cost_gap']
weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
margin = lpw - lpl
scaled_margin = alpha * margin
prob_margin = sigmoid(scaled_margin).clamp(min=eps)
loss_per_pair = exp(-cg) * (-log(prob_margin)) * weight
final_loss = mean(loss_per_pair)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    prob_margin = ops.sigmoid(scaled_margin)
    prob_margin = ops.clamp(prob_margin, min=eps)
    log_prob_margin = ops.log(prob_margin)
    neg_log_prob = ops.neg(log_prob_margin)
    cost_weight = ops.exp(ops.neg(cost_gap))
    loss = ops.mul(cost_weight, neg_log_prob)
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
